caption:
I always figured the 'ghost forest' was just a really high-end rendering—a digital haunting for the nostalgic. But today, my hand didn't pass through the pixels. It hit something solid, vibrating like a live wire. The green foliage rippled like liquid mercury, parting just enough to show a sliver of a sterile, windowless metallic hallway. I’m not looking for new doors today. 

She still can't stop the trembling in her fingertips. 🌿🏙️

#neotokyo #ghostforest #glitch #urbanexploration #2097 #anomaly
